protocol.episode_definition: Any strict drawdown from a running high; [latest equal-or-higher peak anchor, first recovery), half-open
protocol.recovery_boundary: Recovery observation is excluded from the preceding episode. It can become a later episode anchor only if a subsequent strict decline occurs.
protocol.flat_peaks: Each equal peak supersedes the anchor until a strict decline; earlier equal-peak observations are not forced into an episode.
protocol.outside_coverage: Every mature current-bin observation is counted either inside one episode or outside episodes; totals must equal mature_n.
protocol.open_episodes: Recovery index/date are null. observed_stop_exclusive only describes available observations, not an episode recovery.
protocol.information_time: Peak anchors are back-labelled after a later decline; episode boundaries are retrospective evaluation labels and must not enter historical signals.
protocol.counts: episode_count includes recovered and open supported episodes. Neither episodes nor nonoverlap windows are claimed IID independent samples.
protocol.price_basis: Own ETF saved close, not adjclose, for both current buckets and outcomes; frozen source hashes retained. No proxy splice, cash dividends, fees or FX. Vendor corporate-action treatment not independently reverified.
protocol.unchanged_statistics: Episode relabelling does not change mature starts, nonoverlap window count or forward price/loss quantiles from V6.
protocol.main_output: No conditional/unconditional mean difference, p-value, confidence interval or bottom probability is included.
